Boulder Dash
35% of base mana
Instant cast3 min cooldown
Raise a boulder out of the ground and encase yourself within it, preventing you from attacking or casting spells.

For 10 sec, you roll forward at 70% increased movement speed, dealing 1+1.0 Points Per Level+AP*.5+SP*1 Physical damage to enemies you roll over, and you are immune to crowd control effects.
